# 2 Clement — Chapter 20 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 20
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But do not let the wicked one be pleased and lord it over you. You ought not to be distressed, brothers, because this present time is a season of toil and heat and anxiety and affliction.
2. You have come to him as sons, not as strangers. You ought not to fear when you hear that he is coming.
3. For the good shepherd left behind the ninety-nine sheep on the mountains and went seeking the one that had gone astray; and when he found it, he rejoiced over it more than over the ninety-nine.
4. So also our Savior wills that not one of the righteous should perish; and he calls all of us, brothers, to repentance through his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*[Closing doxology, Codex Hierosolymitanus:]*

5. To the only invisible God, the Father of truth, who sent us the Savior and prince of immortality, through whom also he revealed to us the truth and the heavenly life — to him be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
